text:
jamal: Heads up — memory climbs on gpu-* nodes after the exporter reconcile rollout. 3 OOMs so far, all on p4 machine pool.

eva: Saw it too. node-exporter-reconcile process went from ~50MB -> ~800MB in ~10m then got OOMKilled on 3 nodes.

alex: Alert fired: `gpu-exporter-memory` paged 3x. Grafana panel (https://grafana.internal/board/gpu-exporters) shows reconciliation loops spiking scrape concurrency around the same time.

priya: That's the new reconcile controller we merged last week, right? I added exponential backoff but maybe there's still a leak if loops restart.

jamal: Yes. Logs show repeated restarts of `exporter-watcher` with a panic-ish stack in the reconcile path. Snippet:

```
2024-04-04T16:02:11Z exporter-watcher INFO starting reconciliation loop
2024-04-04T16:02:11Z exporter-watcher ERROR runtime: goroutine stack exceeds 1000000000 bytes
2024-04-04T16:02:12Z exporter-watcher KILL OOMKilled
```

lucas: My hunch — the reconcile goroutine is spawning timers/tickers each cycle and never stopping them. Over time they accumulate and consume memory. Immediate mitigation: reduce concurrency. For canary, set `RECONCILE_MAX_CONCURRENCY=1` or patch the DS to use `nodeSelector: gpu-canary` and roll there.

jamal: I patched the canary pool env to `RECONCILE_MAX_CONCURRENCY=1` on two nodes and restarted the pod. Monitoring now.

deploy-bot: Rolled deployment "exporter-reconcile" to gpu-canary: 1/1 updated.

eva: Canary memory dropping back to baseline. No new OOMs in last 6m :thumbsup:.

alex: Ops action items: tune `gpu-exporter-memory` alert to 500Mi and add 10m for transient spikes. Also annotate the alert with runbook: https://runbooks.internal/exporter-memory-leak

priya: I'll open a PR to fix the leak — close timers on each loop and add a test. Targeting patch release tomorrow. Will include telemetry counters to detect leaked timers.

jamal: For now oncall please watch GPU pool for 2 hours and escalate if >1 more OOM. @maya can you ack?

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-345 — exporter reconciliation memory spike. Severity: P2.

maya: Acknowledged. Dashboard pinned in channel. Will escalate if we see >2 nodes affected.

jamal: Commit that introduced the change is `abc1234` (merged Apr 2). If this resurfaces we'll run a full postmortem. Thanks everyone.
